title: add-downgrade-guard-backup-restore-schema-migrations-private-installer
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: Private deployments previously lacked coordinated safeguards for rolling upgrades and downgrades which led to a customer-facing incident when a partial schema migration was applied but a rollback path was not available. This PR adds coordinated version pinning, automated backup/restore primitives, safe schema migration hooks, and a downgrade guard to the private-installer Helm and Terraform assets so customers can upgrade/downgrade reliably. Scope: 1) Add an opt-in downgrade_guard controller flag and Helm values to block harmful downgrades when schema migrations are irreversible. 2) Wire automated pre-upgrade logical backups (Postgres pg_dump + object storage snapshot) and post-upgrade verification steps into the installer upgrade flow with configurable retention. 3) Add migration hooks for ordered schema migrations with explicit up/down SQL and a dry-run verification step. 4) Add version pinning to the private control plane components and surface warnings in the installer CLI if mismatched pinning is detected. 5) Update Terraform modules to expose backup/restore keys and KMS config. Testing and rollout plan: unit tests for migration ordering + dry-run, e2e on perf-canary (private-installer test harness), staged rollout to release/canary clusters, and a final opt-in toggle for early customers. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked: https://linear.app/redwood/board/ENG-7421/upgrade-rollback-automation - [x] Backup/restore integration tests added to perf-canary - [x] Helm values and migration hooks implemented - [x] Terraform inputs/outputs updated and documented - [x] E2E verified on internal canary cluster - [x] Documentation & release notes drafted Backout plan: If a migration shows issues, the downgrade_guard blocks automatic downgrade and signals operator to run the included restore script which restores logical backup and replays pre-upgrade state. For irreversible migrations, the installer will require an explicit force flag and produce a migration report. Related: builds on prior private-installer rollback work (PRs 71245, 63422) and ties into the backup-restore operator introduced in PR 41207.

release_notes: Added coordinated upgrade/rollback tooling for private-installer: opt-in downgrade guard, pre-upgrade backups, ordered schema migrations with dry-run verification, and Terraform/KMS inputs for backup storage. This improves safety for on-prem and VPC private deployments and enables supported downgrades with a documented restore path.
notes: Customer-facing incident SUP-1184 drove this work; backward-compatible by default and gated behind values.downgradeGuard.enabled. Recommend communication to enterprise customers and inclusion in next private-installer release notes.
